indicator_name: KASE indices: the KASE equity index and KASE_TR, corporate bond indices KASE_BMY (yield) and KASE_BMC (price), the money market indicator, government securities capitalisation; monthly average and end of month
description: Индексы KASE: индекс акций KASE и KASE_TR, индексы корпоративных облигаций KASE_BMY (доходность) и KASE_BMC (цена), индикатор денежного рынка, капитализация ГЦБ; в среднем за месяц и на конец месяца
unit: index points (KASE_BMY, MM_INDEX: % per annum; CAPBILLS_KZT: billion KZT)
methodology: Daily closes of KASE's TradingView feed kept as <SYMBOL>.AVG (mean of trading days) and .EOM (last trading day). INDEX_KASE from 2000-07-12 (= 100; 7 916.32 at 2026-10-30, all-time high 8 131.71 on 2026-08-28), KASE_TR from 2020-08, KASE_BMY / KASE_BMC from 2017-09 (BMY 15.50 % on 2026-11-09), MM_INDEX from 2010-01, CAPBILLS_KZT from 2016-10. KASE_BMY is the yield of the corporate bond basket. Equity capitalisation has no history endpoint (monthly figures only in KASE's «Обзор рынка акций» news) and is not kept.
